answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1117 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the wharf. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the grove queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. The plume index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Slashing removes 39 percent at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
